column3: Close to the Hebrew; “lords” renders “seranim,” the Philistine rulers.
Close to the Hebrew; “the Asherahs” are the goddess Asherah or her cult poles.
Close to the Hebrew; “Mesopotamia” renders “Aram Naharaim” (also in verse 10).
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV capitalizes “the Spirit of the LORD.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the City of Palms” is Jericho.
Close to the Hebrew; “the stone images” renders “the carved images,” which some take as “the quarries” (also in verse 26).
Close to the Hebrew; the last clause renders an uncertain word; it may describe the dagger coming out behind or the bowels discharging.
Close to the Hebrew; “the porch” renders an uncertain word.
